verdict.rationale: Khoj documents a first-party WhatsApp client: users can chat with Khoj on WhatsApp without any desktop client and can use slash commands such as /online and /dream there. That covers one of the five messengers in the story, and no evidence shows Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage chat surfaces. Missing for 10: Telegram, Discord, Slack and iMessage messaging clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of the WhatsApp experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page

citations.quote: Without any desktop clients, you can start chatting with Khoj on WhatsApp.
Use slash commands to quickly access Khoj features `/online`: Get responses from Khoj powered by online search.
/dream: Generate an image in response to your prompt.
